description: This PHP class 'HttpKernel' extends Symfony's BaseHttpKernel and manages the HTTP request handling process for the OrangeHRM installer framework. It configures dependency injection, logging, routing, session management, and event subscribers, serving as the core component for processing web requests within the installer module.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Core class extending Symfony's BaseHttpKernel, managing request handling, routing, session, and logging for the installer framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HttpKernel with environment and debug settings, configures container and logger, and sets up core services.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Registers core services like RequestStack, RequestContext, EventDispatcher, ControllerResolver, ArgumentResolver, and sets the HTTP kernel instance.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logger with a log file path, determines log level based on debug mode and file writability, and adds a subscriber.

methods.name: isLogFileWritable
methods.description: Checks if the log file is writable by attempting to append to it.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing by loading routes from a YAML file and adds routing event listeners.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Loads route definitions from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures session storage, ensuring write permissions, and starts the session.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a session object with secure options and storage handler.

methods.name: configureSubscribers
methods.description: Adds event subscribers such as ExceptionSubscriber.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main method to handle an incoming request, setting up subscribers, routing, and session before processing.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.
